tests.description: ENCLOSURE restricted breathing test - FLAMMABLE AESTHETIC MIXTURE WITH AIR at high concentration for at least 30 min without pressure difference inside ENCLOSURE
Gasket or sealing material aging test B-b per IEC 60068-2-2 Clause 15 at 70°C ±2°C for 96 h

Gas-tightness of ENCLOSURE with flexible cord inlets under bending or pulling stress; internal overpressure of 400 Pa created, 30 pulls per Table G.1 applied in axial and least favourable direction for 1 s each; overpressure not to reduce below 200 Pa
External surface operating temperature of ENCLOSURE measured at 150°C in 25°C ambient; steady state operating temperature of ENCLOSURE also measured
CATEGORY APG ME EQUIPMENT, parts and components thereof

ME EQUIPMENT, its parts, and components did not ignite FLAMMABLE AESTHETIC MIXTURE WITH OXYGEN OR NITROUS OXIDE under NORMAL USE and SINGLE FAULT CONDITION; CONTINUOUS OPERATION test after thermal steady state (max 3 h) over 10 min in 12.2% ±0.4 ether by volume/oxygen mixture

Parts and components of CATEGORY APG ME EQUIPMENT operating in FLAMMABLE AESTHETIC MIXTURE WITH OXYGEN OR NITROUS OXIDE; supplied from source isolated from earth by insulation equal to one MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION and from electrical parts by insulation twice the MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION

Test of G.6.1 waived when: a) no sparks produced and temperatures did not exceed 90°C; b) temperature limit of 90°C not exceeded, sparks produced in NORMAL USE and SINGLE FAULT CONDITIONS, except U_max and I_max complied with requirements taking C_max and L_max into consideration
Measured U_max ≤ U_zR with I_zR as in Fig. G.4
Measured U_max ≤ U_zC with C_max as in Fig. G.5
Measured I_max ≤ I_zR with U_zR as in Fig. G.4
Measured I_max ≤ I_zL with L_max and U_max ≤ 24 V as in Fig. G.6

semantic_fragments.content: For CATEGORY APG ME EQUIPMENT per G.6.3 b): U_max is the highest no-load voltage occurring in the circuit under investigation, taking into consideration mains voltage variations as in 4.10. I_max is the highest current flowing in the circuit under investigation, taking into account MAINS VOLTAGE variations as in 4.10. C_max and L_max are values occurring in the relevant circuit. U_max additionally determined with actual resistance R when equivalent resistance R in Fig G.5 was less than 8000 Ω. Peak value taken into consideration when a.c. supplied. An equivalent circuit calculated to determine max capacitance, inductance, and U_max and I_max, either as d.c. or a.c. peak values in case of a complicated circuit. When energy produced in an inductance or capacitance in a circuit is limited by voltage or current-limiting devices, two independent components applied to obtain the required limitation even when a first fault (short or open circuit) in one of these components occurs. Above requirement not applied to transformers complying with this standard.
Extrapolation from Figs G.4, G.5, and G.6 was limited to areas indicated in those figures.
Tests for gas-tightness waived when examination of ENCLOSURE indicated it is completely sealed or gas-tight without a doubt (100% degree of certainty).
